summary: Compile pinned JSON and TOML catalogs with validated policy proposals

delivery.outcome: Deliver issue24 versioned pinned JSON/TOML route catalogs, immutable compilation, schema-aware proposal editor and effective-policy digest evidence through protected OneDev/Validator.
nonGoals: No deployment, active operator file replacement, credentials, transport implementation, provider account reset, paid inference, dependency or package-release change.
Retain legacy Python defaults and runtime TOML configuration for the one-release migration window; catalog activation is explicit and content-pinned, never inferred from a proposal.

architecture.decision: A bounded deterministic compiler builds existing frozen dataclasses and immutable mappings from JSON/TOML. Code retains adapter endpoint/credential bindings, forbidden-model rules and execution bounds. Process-start opt-in requires a raw-file digest; the editor produces a new validated proposal without activating it. Route evidence hashes semantic catalog, effective runtime settings and concrete non-secret route data.

dataChanges.description: Operator-owned catalog/proposal documents remain private component configuration. No cross-component data ownership or execution authority moves.

architecture.rollback: Protected revert restores compatibility defaults; no active operator or deployment configuration is changed.

validation.evidence: Catalog parity, typed malformed input, schema consistency, pinned startup, forbidden adapters/aliases, immutable values, proposal CAS/no-overwrite, unknown routes, effective digest, full stack and independent exact-head delivery.
